property_summary: For any interfaceId in the neighborhood of the canonical ERC165 selector, C.supportsInterface(id) returns true exactly when id is the canonical IERC165 selector (0x01ffc9a7); the mutant dropped the super.supportsInterface(IERC165) clause, so it returns false at that selector, violating the rule.
change_summary: Remove the super.supportsInterface check so only IAccessControl is reported as supported.
